acceptanceCriteria: A static check (doc-gate or go-static step) fails when a non-test file under internal/ or cmd/ ends in a GOOS/GOARCH suffix (_js.go, _wasm.go, ...) without an explicit opt-in list, naming the file and suggesting _jsts.go.
The lane charter/SELF-DEVELOPMENT notes name the pitfall.
body: Residual from V1-1883: a new internal/testsource/*_js.go file silently compiled only for GOOS=js; second lane after V1-1858. No guard or lane guidance exists.
title: Go filenames ending _js.go are GOOS=js-only: lanes adding JS/TS analysers hit it twice (V1-1858, V1-1883)
